stem:
Rina grows a mustard seedling. She places it so sunlight comes only from the right side.

What should she expect?

options.text: The root bends toward the right and the shoot grows straight upward.
The shoot bends toward the right (toward the light) and the root grows downward.
The shoot bends toward the left and the root grows downward.
The shoot grows straight upward and the root grows downward, with no bending toward the light.

teacher.key_rationale: Shoots grow toward sunlight and roots grow downward. Light from the right makes the shoot bend right; the root does not bend toward the light as if it were a shoot.
